children: RNS Number : 6857S  Roundhouse AI Ltd  28 August 2026
28 August 2026
Roundhouse AI LTD.
("Roundhouse" or the "Company")
Proposed Admission to Trading on AIM
Cancellation of Trading on AQSE Growth Market

Roundhouse (AQSE: ETHL), an artificial intelligence technology company, is pleased to announce its intention to apply for the admission of its entire issued and to be issued ordinary share capital ("Ordinary Shares") to trading on the AIM market of the London Stock Exchange ("AIM") ("Admission") and, simultaneously, to cancel the admission of its Ordinary Shares currently admitted to trading on the Access segment of the AQSE Growth Market ("Cancellation").
Background to and reasons for the move to AIM
The Company was admitted to trading on the Access segment of the AQSE Growth Market on 30 January 2026.

Roundhouse is a technology company specialising in artificial intelligence (AI) agent deployment infrastructure. Over the past few months, the Company has further developed its technology considerably and in conjunction with its intended move to AIM will be launching a public analytics dashboard at roundhouseai.io serving as trust and data infrastructure solution for the AI agent economy.

The Directors of the Company (the "Board") consider that a move to AIM at this pivotal stage of its development will be in the best interests of the Company and its shareholders. The Board believes that AIM is a more appropriate market for the Company and that Admission may enable it to attract a wider international pool of investors, potentially improve liquidity in the Ordinary Shares over time and enhance the Company's profile with customers, partners and the wider investment community. The Company intends to raise new capital in conjunction with the Admission and further details will be announced in due course.
Admission process

The Admission process is ongoing, and the Company will make a further announcement in due course when a Schedule One announcement in respect of the Company's intention to move to AIM is published. The Company with its advisers is preparing an AIM admission document which will be published prior to Admission and will be made available on the Company's website at, https://www.roundhouseai.io/.
Cancellation of trading on the AQSE Growth Market

Cancellation of the trading of the Ordinary Shares on the AQSE Growth Market will take place simultaneously with Admission. Following Admission, the Company's Ordinary Shares will no longer be traded on the AQSE Growth Market.
Ticker and ISIN
On Admission, the Company's TIDM is expected to change to RHAI.
The Company's ISIN will continue to be SGXZ84721265 following Admission.
Advisers

Beaumont Cornish Limited is acting as Nominated Adviser to the Company for the purposes of the AIM Rules for Companies in connection with Admission. First Sentinel Corporate Finance Limited is acting as AQSE Corporate Adviser to the Company for the purposes of the AQSE Growth Market Access Rulebook. Clear Capital Markets Limited is acting as Broker to the Company.

About the Company:

Roundhouse is a technology company specialising in AI infrastructure and related operational services. These activities are expected to be the Company's primary revenue driver. The Company intends to generate revenue through the provision of AI infrastructure services, platform licensing and consulting services.
